name: Mixmax
description: Mixmax is a sales-engagement platform for email productivity, automated sequences, scheduling, tracking, templates, team workflows, CRM synchronization, and performance reporting.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned dedicated developer token and one exact 24-character hexadecimal sequence ID. Agents may read only the bound sequence's privacy-redacted name and creation/update timestamps. Relay excludes owners, teams, stages/content, recipients, messages, tracking, CRM data, contacts, live feed, scheduling, reports, integrations, mutations, raw APIs, polling, bulk work, downloads, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read sequence summary
capabilities.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted summary for the exact configured Mixmax sequence ID.

approvalRequired.label: Read sequence summary
approvalRequired.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted summary for the exact configured Mixmax sequence ID.

blocked.label: Change or run sequences
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, sharing, moving, activating, cancelling, scheduling, or changing sequences, stages, folders, and settings is outside V1.

blocked.label: Access recipients or messages
blocked.description: Recipients, contacts, email addresses, message bodies, drafts, templates, snippets, inboxes, live-feed events, sends, replies, calls, and person-level state are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private sequence content
blocked.description: Owner and team IDs, stages, subjects, bodies, variables, CC/BCC recipients, tracking, connected CRMs, schedules, and raw responses are never returned.

blocked.label: Access account or integrations
blocked.description: Users, teams, calendars, appointment links, Salesforce, Google or Microsoft integrations, webhooks, reports, billing, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call raw or bulk surfaces
blocked.description: Raw REST, SDK, CLI, arbitrary endpoints, list/search/filter queries, pagination, polling, imports, bulk work, downloads, exports, and crawling are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded private sequence summary read requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected summary read runs without Relay approval while exact sequence binding, fixed endpoint, audit, redaction, and response bounds remain enforced; recipients, messaging, sequence writes, and integrations stay blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated sequence summary read and keeps the developer token encrypted.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Mixmax account on an annual Growth+ or Enterprise plan, dedicated developer token, exact preconfigured sequence ID, or live API acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task use the intended paid Mixmax account to create a dedicated developer token in Settings > Integrations, choose one preconfigured sequence, record its exact 24-character ID, store both through Relay, then validate the fixed sequence GET, exact binding, privacy redaction, approval/denial, rate-limit handling, token rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without changing, running, or messaging from the sequence.

evidence.supports: Official REST introduction documents customer-created developer tokens, X-API-Token authentication, TLS, Growth+ or Enterprise annual-plan access, direct sequence-resource URLs, field/expansion behavior, a 120-request-per-minute limit, and that the API is not intended for bulk export or warehousing.

Official sequence reference documents sequence IDs, names, timestamps, owners, stages, CC/BCC recipients, variables, tracking, teams, CRM connections, folders, and sharing; Relay returns only the bound ID, bounded name, and timestamps.
Official recipient reference exposes recipient email addresses, states, variables, analytics, and paging, reinforcing V1 exclusion of recipient and person-level data.
Official mutation reference can immediately schedule or send sequence email to supplied recipients; Relay blocks all recipient and messaging writes.

Official privacy policy describes names, email addresses, phone numbers, contacts, calendar content, drafts, sequence/template bodies, recipients, subjects, and engagement activity, reinforcing strict person and message-content exclusion.
